title: Tiny, cute diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- crown top facets -->
    <polygon points='50,18 68,34 50,34' fill='#bff5ff'/>
    <polygon points='50,18 32,34 50,34' fill='#8ee8ff'/>
    <polygon points='68,34 80,50 50,34' fill='#7fd6ff'/>
    <polygon points='32,34 20,50 50,34' fill='#5cc4f0'/>
    <!-- pavilion lower facets -->
    <polygon points='50,34 80,50 50,82' fill='#4fb8f0'/>
    <polygon points='50,34 20,50 50,82' fill='#73d3f5'/>
    <!-- center bright facet -->
    <polygon points='50,34 62,50 50,70' fill='#e8fcff'/>
    <polygon points='50,34 38,50 50,70' fill='#c4f4ff'/>
    <!-- table highlight -->
    <polygon points='50,20 58,28 50,28' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- sparkle -->
    <g opacity='0.9'>
      <polygon points='82,18 84,23 89,25 84,27 82,32 80,27 75,25 80,23' fill='#fff6b0'/>
    </g>
    <!-- tiny sparkle -->
    <g opacity='0.8'>
      <polygon points='18,70 19.5,73 22,74 19.5,75 18,78 16.5,75 14,74 16.5,73' fill='#d9f7ff'/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
